dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……。何でしょう……？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp:
手元に向けていた顔をあげる。頼子さんの手に
は、新しく買ってきた目覚ましがある。
dialogues.en: She repositions herself on the chair and sits up straight.
dialogues.text: She repositions herself on the chair and sits up straight.

dialogues.jp: 「えーとさ、おかしな事を｛き／訊｝くようだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Are you looking for someone?"
dialogues.text: "Are you looking for someone?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Someone......?"
dialogues.text: "Someone......?"

dialogues.jp:
身じろぎし、椅子の上でぴしりと居住まいを正
した。……猫背からはほど遠いな。
dialogues.en:
She puts her hand on her cheek and cocks her head
enquiringly.
dialogues.text:
She puts her hand on her cheek and cocks her head
enquiringly.

dialogues.jp:
「あの、もしかして、頼子さんって、人を捜し
　てる？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I... don't quite...... understand your question."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I... don't quite...... understand your question."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「人……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean......?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean......?"

dialogues.jp: 頬に手を添え、おっとりと首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: "Um, I was wondering if you're searching for someone."
dialogues.text: "Um, I was wondering if you're searching for someone."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、それは、その……」
dialogues.en: "Who is searching for whom?"
dialogues.text: "Who is searching for whom?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「一体……どういう事でしょうか……？」
dialogues.en: "I think Yoriko-san, you're searching for someone."
dialogues.text: "I think Yoriko-san, you're searching for someone."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、そのままの意味なんだけど。もしか
　して、人捜ししてるんじゃないかなっていう」
dialogues.en: "You think I...... I am looking for...... someone......?"
dialogues.text: "You think I...... I am looking for...... someone......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あの、それは……誰が、誰を捜しているので
　しょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「だから、頼子さんが、誰かを」
dialogues.en:
I nod, feeling like I'm talking to a foreigner who finally
understood what I was talking about.
dialogues.text:
I nod, feeling like I'm talking to a foreigner who finally
understood what I was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私……私が……誰かを、ですか……？」

言葉がやっと通じた異邦人の気分を味わいつつ、
こくこく頷く。
dialogues.en:
Quicker than I expected, Yoriko-san shakes her head side to
side.
dialogues.text:
Quicker than I expected, Yoriko-san shakes her head side to
side.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "I am not looking for anyone......"
dialogues.text: "I am not looking for anyone......"

dialogues.jp: あっさり。頼子さんはふるふると首を振った。
dialogues.en: "Oh, you aren't."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you aren't."

dialogues.jp:
湯飲みを口元に持っていき、彼女の目をちらり
とのぞき込む。
dialogues.en: I put the teacup to my lips and take a peep at her eyes.
dialogues.text: I put the teacup to my lips and take a peep at her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
いつもの瞳。応答も自然だし、これで嘘をつい
ているなら、俺は、頼子さんの｛とら／捉｝え方を根本的
に見直さなければならないだろう。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes are normal. She replied very naturally. If she was
lying, I'd have to completely change my perspective about
her.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes are normal. She replied very naturally. If she was
lying, I'd have to completely change my perspective about
her.

dialogues.jp:
「はは……ならいいんだ。あ、じゃあ、俺は二
　階に行ってるから」
dialogues.en:
"Haha...... Then my question is solved. Well, I'm gonna go
upstairs."
dialogues.text:
"Haha...... Then my question is solved. Well, I'm gonna go
upstairs."

dialogues.jp: 湯飲みを置き、席を立つ。
dialogues.en: I put the tea down and left the table.
dialogues.text: I put the tea down and left the table.

dialogues.jp:
思わず階段を駆け上がりたくなる衝動を、なん
とか抑えた。
dialogues.en: I want to run upstairs in joy but I try to calm down.
dialogues.text: I want to run upstairs in joy but I try to calm down.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、どうにもこの嬉しさだけは、抑える事
が出来ない。
dialogues.en: I'm so happy to hear the answer she gave me.
dialogues.text: I'm so happy to hear the answer she gave me.

dialogues.jp: とにかく“与ひょう”は居ないらしかった。
dialogues.en: It means that I'm not the 'nice guy' of The Grateful Crane.
dialogues.text: It means that I'm not the 'nice guy' of The Grateful Crane.

dialogues.jp: ◆“与ひょう”は居ない◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんには誰か恩返しする人がいて、その人
を探しているのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: After dinner, we're drinking tea and I ask her a question.
dialogues.text: After dinner, we're drinking tea and I ask her a question.

dialogues.jp:
そう思った俺は頼子さんに尋ねてみたが、人を
探しているということはないらしい。
dialogues.en: "Ah, y-yes...... What is it......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, y-yes...... What is it......?"

dialogues.jp: 『与ひょう』はいない。
dialogues.en:
I was looking down on my hands on the table, but I look up.
Yoriko-san's holding the new alarm clock I bought her.
dialogues.text:
I was looking down on my hands on the table, but I look up.
Yoriko-san's holding the new alarm clock I bought her.

dialogues.jp: 何故だか嬉しさが抑えられない俺だった。
dialogues.en: "Umm, it might sound strange to ask you this, but......"
dialogues.text: "Umm, it might sound strange to ask you this, but......"
